timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are reportedly waiting to have a baby for this reason.
Ever since Prince Harry and Meghan Markle announced their engagement last November, fans
and the media have been talking about the couple having a baby, even in their engagement
interview, the topic came up, and Harry said that they would hopefully start a family
in the near future.
But now, it looks like the newlyweds might be putting off becoming parents for a little
while, and they have a good reason.
Harry and Meghan will be taking a tour of Australia, New Zealand, Fiji, and the Kingdom
of Tonga later this year, and insiders say that the couple will wait to enter after trip
before trying to start a family.
According to Marie Claire UK, a royal tour is enough of a challenge without the Duchess
of Sussex having to deal with mourning sickness and the dietary and nutritional requirements
of a pregnancy.
However, Royal expert Katie Nichol says that we won't have to wait long after the Duke
and Duchess return from the trip before hearing a pregnancy announcement.
My sources are saying that Prince Harry, particularly, is very keen to start a family, pretty
soon after the royal wedding.
Nichol explained, he's made no secret about wanting children.
I think that moment, for Harry, really kicked in when his brother, Prince William, of course,
settled down with Kate Middleton.
That has definitely gotten Prince Harry pretty broody.
Nichol also said that one of the biggest reasons Harry wanted Meghan to meet Prince George
and Princess Charlotte was so she could see what he wanted for their future, children of
their own.
Some fans were hoping that baby news would come sooner, especially after reports surfaced
that Prince Harry had put his Audi RS6 Avaughn up for sale.
There was speculation that the Prince was upgrading his sports car to a more family-friendly
vehicle.
But, that doesn't seem to be the case just yet.
It looks like we will have to wait at least a few more months before there is a baby
Sussex on the way.
Meanwhile, Harry and Meghan are said to arrive in Australia in October for the Invictus
Games, and a new report claims that the couple has found the perfect place to stay while
they are down under.
It looks like the honor will go to Villa Del Mer, which is a multi-million dollar luxury
home on Point Piper, located in the eastern suburbs of Sydney.
The house has eight bedrooms and over 6,500 square feet, plus breathtaking beach front
views.
In 2015, Lola Wainley, who is married to a former exec in China's renewable energy industry,
bought the home for $41 million.
Meghan Markle and Prince Harry have not commented on the rumors surrounding their future
family.
